Hi RelBench team!

We'd like to submit InRTL to the classification and regression leaderboards.

InRTL (Effective Intra–Inter Interaction Learning for Relational Tables) is our model for relational prediction. The submitted prediction files passed the official RelBench evaluator for all 12 classification tasks and all 9 regression tasks.
